articles.title: Retail Reverberations: The July Sales Dip
articles.description: U.S. retail sales fell by 0.6% in July despite past gains driven by large tax refunds. The decline, due in part to the rescheduling of Amazon's Prime Day and reduced gasoline prices, points to consumers' growing sensitivity to costs. However, rising stock market-driven household wealth offers spending support.

articles.title: VinFast Highlights the EV Equation That's Often Overlooked
articles.description: Gurugram (Haryana) [India], August 14: Electric vehicles are increasingly beating petrol and diesel cars on lifetime ownership costs, yet many buyers continue to judge them by sticker price. Research suggests the industry's next challenge is not improving EV economics but making them easier for consumers to understand.

articles.title: Oil Traders Reprice Hormuz Risk as Demand Outlook Deteriorates
articles.description: Oil prices rebounded this week as stalled U.S.-Iran negotiations restored the Hormuz risk premium, although swelling U.S. inventories and weaker demand forecasts limited the rally.

articles.title: India bonds end week flat, but demand for long notes firms
articles.description: Indian government bonds traded within a narrow range this past week. Fading inflation and rate-hike concerns left traders seeking market direction. Buyers entered long bonds as the yield curve steepened, attracting value. Rising oil prices exerted some pressure, but liquidity and softer inflation eased worries. Expectations now suggest neither the RBI nor the Federal Reserve will raise rates soon.

articles.title: India LPG Consumption Falls 17% To 8.8 Million Tonnes In April-July Amid Hormuz Disruption
articles.description: India’s LPG consumption declined 17% to 8.8 million tonnes during April-July amid supply disruptions linked to the Strait of Hormuz blockade and restrictions on commercial LPG sales. Meanwhile, petrol and diesel demand increased. US LPG supplies surged as Gulf shipments weakened, prompting India to diversify its import sources

articles.title: Global Stocks Soar Amidst Oil Price Surge and Geopolitical Tensions
articles.description: Global stocks are trading at record highs in the face of benign inflation data tamping down US rate hike expectations. Meanwhile, oil prices surge due to stalled Iran peace talks. Investors remain calm despite geopolitical tensions, with a major focus on AI and strong earnings reports.

articles.title: Forex reserves up by $14.1 billion to $707 billion
articles.description: India's foreign exchange reserves saw a jump of over fourteen billion dollars. Foreign currency assets and gold reserves contributed substantially to this overall increase. The Indian Rupee also appreciated slightly against the US dollar on Friday. Forex traders noted pressure on the rupee due to fund outflows and oil prices. Overall reserves have risen considerably since March and over the past year.

articles.title: US markets strive for a positive week ahead of retail sales data and signs of cooling inflation
articles.description: U.S. futures are mixed as Wall Street looks to advance for the week ahead of new retail sales data. The future for the S&P 500 edged 0.1% higher Friday while Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.1%. Nasdaq futures rose 0.1%. The U.S. stock market hit all-time highs Thursday on new data that showed inflation cooled in July, as well as a decline in oil prices. However, oil is rebounding to end the week after two United Arab Emirates tankers were attacked while trying to cross the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Stock markets end lower amid geopolitical uncertainty; Nifty down for fourth day
articles.description: Indian stock markets decline as geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices weigh on investor sentiment, with Nifty down for fourth consecutive day.

articles.title: Electric cars can drive 30km/h faster than petrol cars in this European country
articles.description: A motorway rule in Austria means electric car drivers can legally travel 30km/h faster than petrol and diesel cars when pollution restrictions are activated
